//: Prologue cutscenes. Scripts run with player control locked; see docs/CONTENT_GUIDE.md for commands.

cutscene.opening.narrate: The Sapphire Sea. A fair wind, a full hold, and a ship whose name makes honest merchants lock their cabins.
Her captain has been awake since the middle watch.

cutscene.opening: wick[happy]: Captain! Mister Hale's compliments, and the morning watch is set, and the crew's ready for your rounds!
wick: He said to say it politely.
wick[concerned]: He also said to tell you the cook's in a mood, the quartermaster's in a mood...
wick: ...and Old Finch says the sea's in a mood.
captain[annoyed]: And what mood am I in, Wick?
captain[smug]: Good answer. Tell Hale I'm coming.
captain: Rounds, then. The deck, the galley and the treasure hold...
captain[annoyed]: ...which means the key. Which is in the desk. Where I left it.

cutscene.opening.tutorial: Walk with {btn:move}. Talk and inspect with {btn:confirm}. Hold {btn:run} to run. Open the menu with {btn:menu}.
cutscene.opening.title: Controls

cutscene.galley_argument: mags[angry]: I did NOT eat eleven biscuits, Josiah Quill! I have <y>standards</>!
quill[concerned]: I'm not saying you ate them, Mags. I'm saying they've been eaten, and the ledger doesn't—
quill: Captain. Good. You can settle this.
quill[concerned]: Something's been at the stores. Biscuit, peas, the cheese. I've counted twice.
mags[annoyed]: It's <r>rats</>, Captain. I've seen their leavings in the flour. Filthy beasts.
quill: Then it's rats in the cargo hold. Captain, might I have a word? Properly, I mean.

cutscene.galley_argument.tutorial: New quests go in the Quest Log. Open the menu with {btn:menu} to check your objectives any time.
cutscene.galley_argument.title: Quests

cutscene.rats_intro: Something skitters behind the crates. Several somethings.
jory[determined]: Captain! Mind your boots, they're bold today. Three nests, near as I can tell.
jory: Walk up to one and it'll fight you. Catch one from behind, though, and you get the first blow in.

cutscene.rats_intro.tutorial: Enemies you can see can be fought: touch one to start a battle. Reach it from behind for a first strike, but let one reach your back and it strikes first.
cutscene.rats_intro.title: Battles

then: captain: Rounds done. Rats done. Ledger balanced.
captain[smug]: Not a bad morning's work.

then.sub: Explore, talk to the crew, spar with Rook
